title: 試験：フラッシュプラン

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Eishin Flash comes up to me after our training session.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: There is something I'd like to talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You have been rather unfocused for the past five days. Is it possible you're feeling fatigued?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I have been putting in a lot of overtime lately.
choice_data_list: You hit the nail on the head.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I see. If I may make a suggestion…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Why don't I create the plan for our next training session?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That way, you could use the time normally occupied by schedule planning to rest instead.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I've been thinking about revising my solo training lessons anyway.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I believe this would be a win-win arrangement. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I really appreciate her offer, but still, making training plans is my job as a trainer. Hm… What should I say?
choice_data_list: You know what? Go for it!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …Very well then.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I shall bring a detailed training plan to your office at 8:00 a.m. tomorrow morning.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: This booklet contains today's training plan.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Taking my current abilities into account, I concluded that focusing on speed training would lead to optimal results.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I included a detailed timetable as well. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are a few details I would change, but it's clear she put a ton of effort into this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Taking my current abilities into account, I concluded that focusing on stamina training would lead to optimal results.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I included a detailed timetable as well. What do you think?

text_block_list.text: Taking my current abilities into account, I concluded that focusing on increasing my knowledge would lead to optimal results.

text_block_list.text: I included a detailed timetable as well. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If you say so, then there must be nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Very well. We can carry on our training sessions as usual, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash never really brings up the idea of creating her own training sessions again after that.
